meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.citation: •Effective tax rate is now expected to be between 24% and 25%, a decrease from prior guidance of between 25% and 26%.

•Core Adjusted EBITDA, which is Adjusted EBITDA less lease revenues, is expected to be between $37.35 billion and $37.45 billion, an increase at the midpoint from prior guidance of $37.1 billion to $37.5 billion.

guidances.libelle: Net cash provided by operating activities
guidances.citation: •Net cash provided by operating activities, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $28.7 billion and $28.8 billion, an increase at the midpoint from prior guidance of $28.4 billion to $28.8 billion.

guidances.libelle: Cash purchases of property and equipment
guidances.citation: •Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest, are expected to be approximately $10.0 billion.

•Adjusted Free Cash Flow, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $18.7 billion and $18.8 billion, an increase at the midpoint from prior guidance of $18.4 billion to $18.8 billion. Adjusted Free Cash Flow guidance does not assume any material net cash inflows from securitization.
